## Overview
White-box PR review of the GIOI reservation platform API. Runtime is a TypeScript server exposing public venue/reservation routes and authenticated staff/admin routes backed by Prisma/PostgreSQL. Changed files include auth, CORS, settings, floor-plan/table helpers, migrations, and generated client artifacts.

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions
Unauthenticated internet clients control public route parameters and reservation/feedback inputs. Authenticated staff users control bearer/session credentials and request bodies; admin/host roles are expected to be separated. Database and environment secrets are operator-controlled. Tenant/venue identifiers must not permit cross-venue access. Review is diff-scoped; runtime reachability may require local service setup.

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories
Relevant changed entrypoints are `src/index.ts`, `routes/public/*`, `routes/staff/*`, `lib/auth.ts`, settings/floor-plan/table helpers, and Prisma schema/migrations. Main stories are cross-tenant IDOR/authorization bypass, token/session weaknesses, injection through query construction, unsafe public mutation, and CORS misconfiguration. Generated Prisma files and reports are supporting artifacts, not independent runtime endpoints.

## Severity Calibration
Critical means unauthenticated full compromise or broad cross-tenant/systemic access. High means authenticated low-privilege cross-tenant sensitive data or privileged mutation, SQLi/SSRF/RCE with demonstrated impact. Medium means meaningful single-venue authorization or CSRF/session weakness. Low covers information disclosure and defense-in-depth issues without demonstrated restricted impact.

/workspace/web.content:
## Overview
White-box PR review of the Nuxt web frontend for the GIOI reservation platform. Changed runtime files include public booking/feedback pages, admin/host/guest pages, auth store and API composables, middleware, SEO/server routes, and UI components/assets.

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions
Unauthenticated visitors control venue slugs, booking/feedback codes, query parameters, and form fields. Authenticated staff/admin users control browser requests and tokens; frontend checks are not trusted without API enforcement. Backend APIs and deployment configuration are operator-controlled. Cross-venue and role boundaries must be enforced server-side.

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories
Changed surfaces include Nuxt pages/components, `useApi`/`useGuestApi`, auth store, host-route middleware, server sitemap/llms routes, and public assets. Review focuses on new client-side authorization assumptions, token exposure, XSS/DOM sinks, open redirects, SSRF-like server routes, and sensitive data leakage. Static assets and documentation are context unless they expose secrets or unsafe runtime behavior.

## Severity Calibration
Critical is broad account takeover or systemic cross-tenant compromise. High is a practical path to privileged API actions or sensitive cross-tenant data. Medium is meaningful reflected/stored XSS, auth/session weakness, or authorization bypass constrained to a user/venue. Low is metadata disclosure or defense-in-depth without demonstrated restricted impact.
